name: pikafish-js-workspace
description: Run the Pikafish xiangqi engine in the browser via WebAssembly.

scripts.dev: npm run build:rules && npm run build:engine && npm run dev -w @pikafish-js/demo
scripts.build: npm run build:rules && npm run build:engine && npm run build -w @pikafish-js/demo
scripts.site: npm run build:rules && npm run build:engine && npm run assemble:demo && npm run build:demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pikafish-js/rules && npm run typecheck -w pikafish-js && npm run typecheck -w @pikafish-js/demo
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
